what: Round 6 describe-then-score (DTS) settings: every setting of DECISION_RULE.md section 7 (the rule with rule_sha256), plus the details the rule leaves open, listed under agent_defaults. The GPU jobs (r6_gpu_verbalise.py, r6_gpu_listing.py) and the CPU scorer read this file; its SHA-256 is recorded in every output.

model.loading: AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(<snapshot dir>, max_pixels=200704); Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(<snapshot dir>, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16).to('cuda').eval(); library-default attention, as src/eval/mllm_reranker.py

generation.why_explicit: the snapshot's generation_config.json samples by default (do_sample true, temperature 0.7, top_k 20, top_p 0.8)
generation.greedy_check: every generated token up to and including the first end-of-sequence token equals the argmax of the scores of its step (recorded by a logits processor); every later position is the pad token
generation.decode: tokenizer.decode(the tokens generated after the prompt, skip_special_tokens=True); stored raw, unnormalised

verbaliser.pair: pair i (1 to 4) of a group is (the image of row pairs_x_img[e, i-1], the caption of row pairs_x_txt[e, i-1]), in episode column order

message.layout: one user turn: Group A header, its 4 pairs (each: pair label, image, pair caption), Group B header, its 4 pairs, then the wording; text parts are joined by the chat template with no separator

wordings.W1: Each pair is a painting and a caption. What do the pairs in Group A share that the pairs in Group B lack? Answer with a short phrase.
wordings.W2: In each pair of Group A, the painting and the caption match in one respect. In each pair of Group B, they match in a different respect. In a short phrase, name the respect in which the pairs of Group A match.
wordings.W3: The pairs in Group A count as similar; the pairs in Group B do not count as similar under the same criterion. In a short phrase, state the criterion.
wordings.W4: In at most five words, name the property that links the two items of each pair in Group A but not those in Group B.

verbaliser.phrase: the first line of the answer (first_line), normalised (normalisation)

first_line: s = answer.strip(); the first element of s.splitlines(), or '' when s is empty (Python str.strip, str.splitlines)

steps: whitespace: every run matched by re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s) (Unicode whitespace) becomes one space
ends: repeatedly remove the first and the last character while it is whitespace (c.isspace()) or Unicode punctuation (unicodedata.category(c) starts with 'P')
normalisation.applies_to: the phrase (the first line of the verbaliser's answer) and every listing line after its list marker is removed

listing.prompt: List {K} distinct values of the following criterion for describing paintings: {phrase}. One value per line, no numbering.
listing.message: one user turn whose content is one text part, the prompt; text only, no image
listing.parse: for each line of answer.splitlines(): remove one leading list marker (re.sub(marker_regex, '', line, count=1)), then normalise; drop empty lines and repeated lines (the first occurrence kept); keep the first K
listing.cache: one listing per (normalised phrase, K), reused across runs

parsing_failure: a phrase that is empty, or whose listing gives fewer than 2 values, gives T_DTS^c = 0 on that episode and condition (the fused score is then cosine); counted per setting and condition and reported

scorer.name: CRL (Liu et al., NeurIPS 2025)
scorer.embedding: each value as written (the normalised string, no template) through the CLIP B/32 text encoder of the feature cache (openai/clip-vit-base-patch32; src/data/feature_extract.ClipB32), unit-normalised; the K embeddings form the basis
scorer.projection: each item maps to the vector of its cosines with the K value embeddings: image items through the cached CLIP image features, caption items through the cached text features (R = I T^T on unit vectors)
scorer.term: T_DTS^c(query, candidate) = the cosine of the two vectors, with the phrase of condition c

fusion: T_DTS^c fused with cosine by fused_scores (zfuse); lambda by crossfit_lambda (LAMBDA_GRID with its edge extension)

controls.DTS-CF: the mean of z(T_DTS^a) and z(T_DTS^b) per ranking row, averaged in float64 then cast to float32, equal in both conditions (asserted), z-scored again inside zfuse, fused by crossfit_lambda

DTS-N.rule: the phrase replaced by the target aspect's name (privileged), then listed and scored as DTS

seed42_order.rows: selection rows only, seed 42, 4,096 episodes per pair (12,288)
seed42_order.sanity: first DTS-N at K 8 and K 16 on all 12,288 episodes; its pooled condition gain point (cross-fitted fused) must be above 0 at each K
seed42_order.tuning_score: (R@1 + condition gain) / 2 of the cross-fitted fused scores on the 3,072 tuning episodes; ties go to the first setting in tuning_settings order
seed42_order.chosen: the chosen setting runs on all 12,288 episodes; its lambda picks per half, DTS-CF's and DTS-N's (at the chosen K), the wordings, the model revision, the parsing-failure counts and every setting's score go to results/dts_seed42.json; held episodes use the chosen setting and these picks

built: DTS counts as built when the sanity has passed and the chosen setting has run on all 12,288 seed-42 episodes

stop.rule: DTS's hit count is the sum over the 12,288 seed-42 episodes, pooled over the three pairs, of 4*R@1 of its cross-fitted fused scores (r2_fusion.as_int4); if it is greater than AFF's, the build stops before the read and the user decides; only DTS counts

budget.from: the first commit of DTS code (Amsterdam time in the round log)

agent_defaults: verbaliser.message: the group headers 'Group A:' and 'Group B:', each pair as the 8B probe's pair block ('Pair i: image', the image, '\ncaption: <caption>\n'), pair numbers restarting at 1 in Group B, and one blank line before the wording
first_line: the answer stripped of surrounding whitespace, then split by str.splitlines
normalisation: the Python operations of its steps (lower(), \s+ runs, Unicode category P* and whitespace stripped at both ends)
generation.listing.batch_size 16 with left padding, inputs in the listing input's order
generation.generate_kwargs and greedy_check (the rule says greedy; the snapshot's defaults sample)
model.loading from the pinned snapshot directory of the hub cache
